What I eat in a day as a gamer girl who lifts 🎮🏋️‍♀️
I sit 9 hours a day, so food has to keep me full and strong

Breakfast 🍌
Oats soaked in yogurt with banana, walnuts and a spoon of peanut butter. Black tea on the side, always ☕

After the gym 🥞
Cocoa pancakes with Greek yogurt, walnuts, a little honey and cinnamon. Tastes like dessert, keeps me full till lunch

Lunch, meal-prepped 🥔
Roasted potatoes, broccoli and carrots with homemade meatballs. I cook once and eat it for 4 days

Then stream time 🎧
My only rule: protein at every meal, so I'm not raiding the snack drawer at midnight 😅
